Definition: Public analytical mechanics implemented by the solver: geometry, stiffness, loads, stress recovery, units, reports.
Code text, tables, figures, code-derived formulas, allowables, SIF/flexibility tables, protected dimensional tables.
Notes: Must not be shipped publicly unless explicit redistribution rights exist.

Definition: Values, formulas, allowables, SIFs, flexibility factors, load combinations, and interpretations entered by the user.
Notes: May be stored in private project/rule-pack files.

Definition: A solved numerical model with displacements, reactions, forces, moments, and mechanical stresses.
Notes: Not equivalent to a code check.

Definition: A user-defined expression/comparison applied to solver outputs.
Human acceptance for reliance by a competent/responsible professional.
A 3D line-element representation of the piping centerline and components.
The code-neutral 3D frame mechanics core that owns DOF ordering, element stiffness, transforms, assembly, boundary-condition reduction, and a bounded solve interface.
Notes: Consumes unit-checked numeric inputs; does not perform rule checks or professional approval.

Definition: A deterministic mechanics-solver finding for singularity, invalid topology/restraints, numeric invalidity, conditioning, nonconvergence, or unresolved solver configuration.
Notes: Not a rule-pack result, code-compliance statement, or professional acceptance.

Definition: A transfer package for local shell/solid analysis.
Notes: Specialized workflow, not the default global solver.

Definition: A declared extension metadata record that requests entrypoints, permissions, provenance, privacy posture, checksums, sandbox requirements, and no-bypass constraints.
Notes: A manifest grants nothing by itself.

Definition: A governed boundary where a plugin or adapter may request to import, export, validate, report, emit diagnostics, or expose user-owned rule-pack metadata.
Notes: Exact loader and transport remain TBD.

Definition: The model, persistence, unit, analysis-boundary, rule-pack metadata, result, report, or diagnostic surface touched by an extension entrypoint.
Notes: Must be declared in the plugin manifest.

Definition: A mandatory control that plugins and adapters must preserve, including units, provenance, privacy, protected-content, diagnostics, hashes, rule sandboxing, reports, solver boundaries, and human acceptance boundaries.
Notes: Cannot be waived by plugin code.

Definition: User-owned schema-governed artifact defining required inputs, declarative formula slots, user-supplied value slots, user-rule check definitions, provenance, redistribution status, diagnostics, checksums, and professional-boundary flags.
A human has recorded project-specific acceptance outside the solver core.
Notes: Human record only; not an automatic software status.

Definition: Numerical mechanics solve completed; solver result only.
Mechanics may be solved but rule-pack required values are missing; a rule-pack finding.
Result requires competent engineering review before reliance.
Notes: Always true for professional use; automatic status.
